hieroglyphic_preservation_policy.original_definition: Authoritative Sethe/TLA facsimile or witness, not model-generated glyphs.
hieroglyphic_preservation_policy.why_not_embed_linear_unicode: TLA can encode hieroglyphs but multiple witnesses explicitly note that quadrats are not arranged as in the original; a model-generated linearization would not be the original layout.
hieroglyphic_preservation_policy.json_storage: Each stage stores exact Sethe volume/Spruch/Pyr section and verified TLA witness ID where available.
hieroglyphic_preservation_policy.future_option: If binary facsimile assets are added, bind each crop by SHA-256 to this manifest.
